paite: Huan huai thilte nung in hichi ahong hi a, Jezreel mi Naboth in Jezreel ah grephuan anei a, huai Samaria kumpipa Ahab inn kiang a om hi.
heading: Naboth Grephuan

paite: Ahab in Naboth kiang ah, "Ka inn kiang a om ahih ziak in antehlouhing huan ding in na grephuan hon pia in. Asik in grephuan hoihzaw ka hon pe ding. Ahihkei a na deih zawkleh lah adangka in ama'n hun ding ka hon pe ding," chi in agen hi.
Naboth in Ahab kiang ah, "TOUPA'N ka pu ka pate gou nang ka hon piak ding aphal kei," achi hi.

Jezreel mi Naboth in huchibang thu akiang a agen ziak in Ahab ngui leh lungkim loutak in a-inn ah alut hi; ka pu ka pate gou ka hon pe thei het kei ding, achi bikbek ngal a. Huchi in alupna ah alum a, khat lam anga a, an ane kei hi.
Huchi in azi Jezebel ava hoh a, akiang ah, "Bangchidan ahia na lungsim huchitak a alungkham a, an na nek louh?" achi hi.

Ama'n akiang ah, "Naboth kiang ah, na grephuan hon leisak in, ahihkeileh na deih zawkleh asik in grephuan dang ka hon pe ding ka chi hi. Ama'n, ka grephuan zaw ka hon pe thei het kei ding, chi in ahon dawng a ahi," achi hi.
Azi Jezebel in akiang ah, "Israel gam kumpipa na hi kei a hia? Thou inla, an ne inla, lungsim nuamtak in om in. Ke'n Jezreel mi Naboth grephuan ka hon pe ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Ahab min in laithonte agelh a, Ahab suainamna in suai anam a, Naboth invengte a-upate leh makaite kiang ah akhak hi.
Laithonte ah, "An ngolh na puang unla, mipi lak ah Naboth ma kaisak un.
Belial tate mi nih ama ah tusak unla, nang Pathian leh kumpipa na gensia hi, chi a amah hek ding mi ana bawl un. Huchi in amah pikhia unla, suang in ana denglum un," achi hi.
Atenna khua a upate leh makaite'n Jezebel in akiang ua akhak laithon akigelh bang in ana hihta uhi.
An ngolh apuang ua, mipi lak ah Naboth a makaisak uhi.
Belial tate mi nih hong pai in ama ah ava tu ua; Belial tate'n mipite ma ah, Naboth in Pathian leh kumpipa agensia, chi in amah ahek uhi. Huchi in khua a pan apokhia ua, suang in adeng ua, asita hi.
Jezebel kiang ah, "Naboth suang in adeng ua, asita," chih hilh ding in mi asawl uhi.

Jezebel in Naboth suang in adeng ua, asita chih azak in hichi ahong hi a, Jezebel in Ahab kiang ah, "Thou inla, Jezreel mi Naboth grephuan, ahon leisak phal louh neita aw le. Naboth adam nawnta kei, asita hi," achi hi.
Ahab in Naboth asita chih azak in hichi ahong hi a; Jezreel mi Naboth grephuan nei dia kuansuk ding in Abab athouta hi.
Tishbi mi Elijah kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a:
heading: Ahab Tung A Pathian Vaihawmna

paite: "Thou inla, Samaria a om Israel kumpipa houpih ding in hohsuk in. Ngai in, Naboth grephuan ah a-om a, neih tum in huai ah ahohsuk hi.

Akiang ah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: 'Na that a, na neihsak behlap lai maw? chi inla, akiang ah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, ui in Naboth sisan aliahna mun mah ah nang sisan leng aliak ding uh' na chi ding," achi hi.
Ahab in Elijah kiang ah, "Na hong muta maw, ka melmapa?" achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Hon muta ka hi ve; TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih lou hih dia nang leh nang na kikhotkhiak tak ziak in.
Ngai in na tung ah thil hoih lou ka tungsak dia, na suante ka lamang dia, Ahab a pan a ta pasal taphot Israel gam a mi zalen hi in zalen lou hitaleh ka satkhe ding.
Nang na hon hehsak ziak in leh Israelte thil na hihkhelhsak ziak in Nebat tapa Jeroboam inkote leh Ahijah tapa Baasha inkote bang mai in na inkote ka bawl ding," achi hi.
Jezebel tungtang thu leng TOUPA'N agen a, "Jezebel khokulh chin ah uite'n ane ding uh.
Ahab inkote lak a mi khopi a si peuhmah uite'n ane ding ua; gam a si peuhmahte tung a leng vasate'n ane ding uh," achi hi.
Azi Jezebel tohthoh a TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih lou hih dia amah-le-amah kikhawngkhia Ahab bang mi kuamah a-om kei hi.
TOUPA'N Israel suante ma a delhkhiaksa Amorte thilhih chiteng bang in milimte bia in thilkihhuaitak ahih hi.
Ahab in huai thu azak in hichi ahong hi a, apuan abotkek a, sai-ip puan asilh hi. An angawl a, sai-ip puan ah alum a, kidawmtak in apai hi.
TOUPA thu Tishbi mi Elijah kiang ah ahong tung hi.
"Ka ma a Ahab akiniamkhiakdan na mu hia? Akiniamkhiak ziak in adamsung in hiai thil hoih lou ka tungsak kei dia, atapa damsung in bel a-inkote tung ah hiai thil hoih lou ka tungsak ding," achi hi.
